title: Temporal Conditioning for Human Behavioral Cloning in Chess
abstract: arXiv:2611.33106v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Behavioral cloning models in chess typically predict human moves from board states while ignoring temporal inputs such as the remaining clock. However, time pressure is a major determinant of human decision-making quality, and temporal state is a missing dimension of human behavioral modeling. This paper introduces a time-aware transformer that extends a Chessformer-style architecture with learned temporal conditioning tokens encoding player clock state, time control, and recent tempo, together with behavioral heads for thinking time and resignation. The model is trained on large-scale online chess data and evaluated against time-agnostic baselines and the state of the art. Results show that temporal conditioning yields modest overall accuracy improvements but substantially stronger gains under time pressure. translated_title: 国际象棋中人类行为克隆的时间条件化方法
translated_abstract: 国际象棋中的行为克隆模型通常仅根据棋盘状态预测人类走法，而忽略了诸如剩余时间等时间输入。然而，时间压力是人类决策质量的主要决定因素，时间状态是人类行为建模中缺失的一个维度。本文提出了一种时间感知Transformer模型，它在Chessformer风格架构的基础上进行扩展，引入了可学习的时间条件化标记，用于编码玩家的时钟状态、时间控制和近期行棋节奏，并配备了用于预测思考时间和认输行为的行为预测头。该模型在大规模在线国际象棋数据上训练，并与时间无关的基线模型和当前最先进的模型进行了对比评估。结果表明，时间条件化带来了适度的整体准确率提升，但在时间压力下获得了显著更大的性能收益。除了走子选择之外，它还能产生更准确的思考时间和认输预测。更重要的是，该模型能够更好地……
tldr: 本文提出时间感知Transformer模型，将剩余时钟时间等时间信息编码进国际象棋行为克隆模型，在时间压力下显著提升了人类走法预测准确率，并能更准确地预测玩家的思考时间和认输行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a time-aware transformer with learned temporal conditioning tokens for chess behavioral cloning, substantially improving move prediction accuracy under time pressure while enabling more accurate predictions of thinking time and resignation.
